_schema: Room content. The renderer's trust boundary, enforced in room.js:
_plain: PLAIN TEXT, escaped on render: cards[].name, groups[].title, groups[].symbols[].n
_raw: RAW AUTHORED HTML, injected as-is: cards[].body, cards[].note, examples[].q, examples[].steps[], examples[].ans, groups[].symbols[].g
_rule: Anything moved between those two lists changes what the browser does with it. Plain fields must never contain markup; raw fields are trusted and must never hold anything a reader typed.

cards.name: Mole relationship
cards.note: moles = mass ÷ molar mass. Rearrange for whichever one you need.

cards.name: Avogadro's number
cards.note: particles per mole — the bridge between counting and weighing.

cards.name: Empirical formula
cards.body: smallest whole-number mole ratio of the elements
cards.note: % → assume 100 g → moles → divide by the smallest → multiply up to whole numbers.

cards.name: Molecular formula
cards.body: molecular = empirical × n, where n = (molecular mass) / (empirical mass)
cards.note: You need a measured molar mass to get from one to the other.

cards.name: Balancing equations
cards.body: Same count of every element on both sides. Change coefficients only — never subscripts.
cards.note: Changing a subscript changes the substance.

cards.name: Mole ratio
cards.body: The coefficients of a balanced equation are a ratio of moles, not masses.
cards.note: This is the step students skip; masses never go straight into a ratio.

cards.name: Limiting reagent
cards.body: Convert each reactant to how much product it could make. The smallest wins.
cards.note: It runs out first and caps the yield; the rest is left over.

cards.name: Percent yield
cards.note: Above 100% usually means the product is still wet.
